summary: Petrol, diesel prices today — 24 June: Global Oil prices eased as tankers navigated the Strait of Hormuz amid progress in US-Iran peace talks, with Brent crude closing above $77 a barrel. Check fuel rates in Chennai, Bengaluru, Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai and other cities.
